Name: I'm Kimjang
Author: podopo11
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]


I'm Kimjang is a Content Patcher mod that adds Korean kimjang-themed crops, ingredients, foods, recipes, letters, gift tastes, and dialogue to Stardew Valley.

Experience farming that no longer feels empty even in winter!

Grow winter cabbage, prepare salted cabbage, dry hot peppers, make red pepper powder, and cook three kinds of kimchi: Kimjang Kimchi, Green Onion Kimchi, and Kkakdugi.

This mod was made to bring the feeling of kimjang, the Korean tradition of preparing kimchi for the colder months, into Stardew Valley in a simple vanilla-friendly way.[b][size=4]



Installation instructions[/size][/b]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Download this mod and unzip it.
4. Place the [CP] I'm Kimjang folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
5. Run the game through SMAPI.



[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]

- Adds Cabbage Seeds, Cabbage, Salted Cabbage, Dried Hot Pepper, Red Pepper Powder, Kimjang Kimchi, Green Onion Kimchi, and Kkakdugi.
- Adds winter cabbage seeds sold at Pierre's shop.
- Adds machine processing using the Preserves Jar and Dehydrator.
- Adds cooking recipes for Kimjang Kimchi, Green Onion Kimchi, Kkakdugi, and Red Pepper Powder.
- Adds seasonal recipe letters from Jodi, Leah, and Caroline.
- Adds custom gift tastes and gift dialogue.
- Adds kimchi-themed NPC dialogue.
- Includes Korean and English localization.

[left][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4][font=Arial][b]Requirements[/b][/font][/size][/left]

Required:
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

Optional:
- Stardew Valley Expanded

If Stardew Valley Expanded is installed, this mod adds extra gift taste and dialogue support for Andy, Martin, and Morgan.



[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.15.

This is a Content Patcher-only mod. It does not require Json Assets, SpaceCore, or Producer Framework Mod.


[b][size=4]
Notes[/size][/b]


This is my first time making and sharing a Stardew Valley mod, so I may still have a lot to learn. If you find any bugs or issues, please report them through the Bugs section and I will check them when I can.

Community translations are welcome! If you would like to translate this mod into another language, you may upload your own translation patch or contact me about adding the translation file to this mod.

If this mod made your winter farm feel a little less empty, donations are greatly appreciated!

https://paypal.me/junimoyeon

[b][size=4]Updates[/size][/b]

1.0.1

- Adjusted the Dehydrator recipe for Dried Hot Pepper.
- You now need 5 Hot Peppers to make 5 Dried Hot Peppers.

1.1.0

Version 1.1.0 Update

This update adds three new cooking items: Minced Garlic, Kimchi Pancake, and Kimchi Fried Rice.

Minced Garlic can be made in the kitchen using 2 Garlic, and it is now required for the Kimjang Kimchi, Green Onion Kimchi, and Kkakdugi recipes.

Robin sends the Kimchi Pancake recipe on Winter 5, and Shane sends the Kimchi Fried Rice recipe on Winter 20.

Kimchi Pancake and Kimchi Fried Rice are liked by all NPCs, with several characters having unique loved-gift reactions. New dialogue related to these dishes has also been added.

New items:
- Minced Garlic
- Kimchi Pancake
- Kimchi Fried Rice

Other changes:
- Added Minced Garlic and Powdered Chili to the cooking collection.
- Updated item prices, descriptions, sprites, and gift tastes.
- Updated the Kimjang Kimchi buff icon and description.
- Powdered Chili and Minced Garlic now reduce energy when eaten.
- Existing kimchi recipes now use Minced Garlic instead of regular Garlic.

1.1.1

Added the Nexus update key so SMAPI can notify users about future updates. No gameplay or content changes.



[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

Delete the previous [CP] I'm Kimjang! folder before installing this update. Do not merge the new files with the old folder.

[b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]

Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and the creators of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
